tools.name: track_flight_by_callsign
tools.description: Retrieve real-time global ADS-B aircraft telemetry by ATC callsign (e.g. "UAL921", "BAW117"), 6-char ICAO24 hex address, tail registration (e.g. "N663UA"), or 4-digit squawk. Returns live lat/lon, barometric altitude (ft & flight level), groundspeed (kts), track/heading, vertical rate, aircraft type

tools.name: get_airspace_flights_nearby
tools.description: Scan all live ADS-B aircraft within a 1–250 nautical mile radius around any lat/lon coordinates or airport IATA/ICAO code (e.g. airport="LHR" or lat=51.47, lon=-0.4543, radius_nm=50). Returns aircraft sorted by distance_nm with live altitude, speed, heading, and airline. Cost: 2 Credits / aircraft r

tools.name: get_faa_airport_delays
tools.description: Check live FAA National Airspace System operational status including Ground Stops, Ground Delay Programs, Arrival/Departure Delays, and Airport Closures. Pass an optional 3-letter US IATA airport code (e.g. "JFK", "EWR", "MIA", "SFO") or omit for all active US delays nationwide. Cost: 5 Credits / ca

tools.name: lookup_airport_or_airline
tools.description: Instant lookup across 49,000+ global airports and 6,100+ airlines by name, city, IATA code, ICAO code, or country ISO code. Returns exact coordinates, elevation, timezone, ICAO/IATA codes, and airline callsigns. Cost: 2 Credits / call.
